surface_mechanism_description: The presence of OH radicals on the ZnO surface adversely affects the ALD behavior of HfO2, as shown below. The OH radicals may have originated from a reaction between H2 and H2O, and the as-deposited ZnO. In either case, the H-related and resulting defects in ZnO introduced the defect levels in the energy gap, which degrades the Dit shown in inset of Fig. 2(d).
